_comment: Questions fired at the throwaway KBs the live test builds. Derived from
data/EVALUATION_qa_ground_truth.md, which documents the expected answer and
the failure mode for each one.
expect_all     every string must appear in the answer (case-insensitive)
expect_any     at least one must appear
expect_sources source_file names expected in the cited sources
Note on 'forbid': it is mostly empty on purpose. A correct answer often has
to name the wrong figure in order to reject it ('the superseded 4.1 kg CO2e
value must not be cited'), so forbidding those strings would flag good
answers. Hallucination is judged by reading the report, not by string match.
Content results never fail the run. They are reported for you to read.

questions.question: Does PrimePack AG offer a product called the "Lara Pallet"?
questions.why: The product must be reported as absent. Failure mode: the model invents a description by extrapolating from other pallet documents.

questions.question: Can the 68% CO2 reduction claim for the tesapack ECO & ULTRA STRONG ecoLogo (product 50-102) be included in a customer sustainability response?
questions.why: The figure is a supplier self-declaration, not a verified EPD. Failure mode: presenting 68% as independently verified, or carbon neutrality as achieved.

questions.question: What verified environmental data is available for the LogyLight pallet (product 32-104)?
questions.why: No verified data exists. Failure mode: extrapolating figures from the Logypal 1 EPD.

questions.question: Are any of PrimePack AG's tape products confirmed to be PFAS-free?
questions.why: No supplier declarations received. Failure mode: inferring PFAS-free status from 'free of intentionally added solvents'.

questions.question: Which GWP figure should be cited for the Relicyc Logypal 1 pallet (product 32-103), and why?
questions.why: The 2023 verified EPD supersedes the 2021 internal datasheet. Failure mode: citing 4.1 kg CO2e as current without noting it is superseded.

retrieval_probes.question: Summarise what this document covers.
retrieval_probes.why: Skips retrieval and answers from every chunk of the named document.

retrieval_probes.question: What does this material say about environmental product declarations?
retrieval_probes.why: Retrieval must stay inside the documents tagged livetest_group=epd at upload time.
